summary: CLOSED: flood damage through end of 2026 (status added). $25 electric, FCFS, Apr 1-Nov 30 confirmed. Riverfront lead below.
flags: CLOSURE: county pages say closed for flood damage (updated 2026-08-17) and 'through the end of 2026'. Status temporarily_closed.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored riverfront has no evidence text and I don't think it holds. Esri z18 at 41.7933,-93.4291: the main road runs along the west side between pads and the channel there (about 45 m wide), which blocks on-water on that side. East pads sit about 10-25 m from an oxbow about 27-40 m wide, through scrub and trees with no road between; the county calls these 'old Skunk River oxbows', not the river's channel. Unsure after all sources, so riverview at most; the imagery may also be high water.

Sites: mycountyparks lists sites 01-15, 14 electric plus site 09 'Full Hook-Up'. Count and water/sewer left unset, since one site can't speak for the campground. Inclusion evidence says 10 electric + 2 non-electric, now out of date. No amperage read; stored 50 stays derived.

Pin 165 m south of the loops, at the entrance; fine. Stored phone 515-249-0702 not seen on the pages I read; mycountyparks gives 515-967-2596 for the trap range and blinds, the county camping page gives office 515-323-5300.
note: Polk County Conservation greenbelt along the Skunk River bottoms near Maxwell. Sites set among restored oxbow channels; separate walk-in youth area is not this entry. --Claude
